diagnosis.code_finding: JsonlIndexPipelineStore.reload() did path.read_text().splitlines() and json.loads() on every line before compacting. Every run line persists the full indexed_object_ids checkpoint (~28.8k ids, ~1-2 MB/line, up to 500 lines retained). reload() runs on every /index/refresh, /index/source-completions, /index/freshness and pipeline-runs call, so the post-restart mix (87 source-completions + 6 refresh + 6 materialize) allocated file-size text + all parsed id lists per call, concurrently across request threads.
diagnosis.bounded_allocation: Pipeline-run JSONL reload. Now streamed line-by-line and each run compacted as the next arrives: peak is one line in flight plus the latest run's id list (the next run's baseline).
diagnosis.not_ruled_out: Model load (multilingual-e5-large ONNX), repository.reload, and query-time allocations were not measured; model load is a fixed cost. If hosted memory.peak is still above 70% (9.1 GiB) after release, treat as residual finding for those phases.
